name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - Tracy CA

fieldNotes.location: 1700 E Pescadero Ave, Tracy CA = Tracy Pescadero Distribution Center, a 381,600 SF Class A regional DC on a 19.46-acre site, completed 2016 by Ridgeline Property Group / LaSalle. Spec: 57 dock-high doors, 2 drive-in doors, 185 ft truck court, 92 trailer parking spaces, 317 auto parking spaces. Historically split-leased to Pactra and DHL; GXO Logistics now operates here per Racklify and Bandana 3PL directories. Building is an L-shaped multi-tenant distribution building just south of I-205 with a large interior auto-parking lot. Roster GEOMETRIC_CENTER geocode (5 m) landed correctly on this parcel.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint visible at the E Pescadero Ave driveway entrances. The west and interior auto-parking areas are fully open and unfenced (2023 Street View). Two drive entrances serve the site off E Pescadero. Classified false; flagged uncertain since the truck-side dock area is partly tree-screened from the road.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth observed at any entrance.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate present, so no remote check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 57 dock-high doors per developer spec; dock indents visible along the building's south face - 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 92 trailer parking spaces per spec; only a few trailers visible in imagery (estimated 4). Recorded 0-10 band for trailers parked without tractors; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Dock apron and driveway approach are shallow; the site is compact (19.46 acres) with limited internal queuing depth.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Two separate driveway entrances off E Pescadero Ave provide distinct in/out points; flagged uncertain as exact lane assignment is not visible.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located within the Northeast Industrial Specific Plan Area of Tracy, a dense Central Valley industrial / logistics district immediately south of I-205.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 19.46-acre site per developer documentation; perimeter box yields ~16.5 acres (box excludes some peripheral landscaping).
